director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek poore ke barabar hisse karke bhinn banayenge. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Ghar mein ek roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hai. Har bachche ke hisse ka ek pakka naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rang wala ek hissa poori roti ka 1/4 hai, ek-chauthaai. Poore ke barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: 8/1 sahi nahi hai. Bhinn ka neeche wala number batata hai ki poora kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Bagal wali roti ke hisse gino. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon. Bagal wali roti bhi utni hi badi hai, par uske 8 barabar hisse kiye hain. Uska ek hissa poori roti ka kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Bagal wali roti bhi utni hi badi hai, par uske 8 barabar hisse kiye hain. Uska ek hissa poori roti ka kaunsa bhinn hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon.

director.text: ek aathvaan

Bilkul sahi, kyunki roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Dono pattiyan 12 cm ki hain aur dono ke 3 hisse hain. A ke teeno hisse 4 cm ke hain, barabar, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse 6, 3 aur 3 cm ke hain, toh unmein se koi bhi 1/3 nahi. Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: 7 cm

Nahi, 7 cm theek nahi. Teeno hisse barabar honge aur milkar poori patti banayenge. Socho, kaunsi lambai teen baar jodne se 15 cm banti hai. 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisson mein har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan wahi 15 cm ki patti gol ban gayi hai, teen barabar hisson mein. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: 4 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Teen dost 12 cm ki chocolate baantein. Patti A jaisa baanto toh sabko 4 cm milta hai, aur har ek ka hissa 1/3 hai. Patti B jaisa baanto toh ek ko 6 cm aur do ko 3 cm, aur kisi ka hissa 1/3 nahi. Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: 6 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. 1/3 tabhi hota hai jab teeno hisse barabar hon. A ke teeno hisse 4 cm ke hain; B mein ek bada hissa aur do chhote hain. 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisson mein har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo. Toh suno, sawaal yeh hai. Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: 5 centimetre

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, teen barabar hisse milkar poori 15 cm ki patti. Ribbon P 20 cm ki hai, toh uska 1/2 10 cm hai. Ribbon Q 12 cm ki hai, toh uska 1/2 sirf 6 cm hai. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: 2 cm zyada

Haan, bilkul theek: P ka 1/4 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cm, Q ka 12 ÷ 4 = 3 cm, toh fark 2 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa bhinn hai? Bhinn batane se pehle kya pata karna hoga?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: kitne hisse

Haan, pehle yeh ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. 30 cm mein 6 cm ke hisse gino: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 hisse, kyunki har hissa 6 cm ka hai, aur 5 × 6 = 30. Tumhari baari: ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: one fifth

Sahi jawab. Dekho, neeche wala number hisson ki ginti hai, hisse ki lambai nahi. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 6, 2 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 6, 2 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata

Socho, chocolate chaar barabar hisson mein toot-ti toh har hissa kitna lamba hota. Phir dekho kaunse hisse utne lambe hain. 16 cm ki chocolate ke 6, 6, 2 aur 2 cm wale hisson mein se kitne hisse 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 6, 2 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

director.text: 0 hisse

Bilkul sahi: 16 cm ka 1/4 16 ÷ 4 = 4 cm hota, aur koi bhi hissa 4 cm ka nahi, toh 0 hisse. Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Kiska hissa lamba hai, Rahul ka ya Sana ka?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Kiska hissa lamba hai, Rahul ka ya Sana ka?

director.text: Rahul

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm, toh Rahul ka lamba. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Achha, toh tumhe sixer sabse achha lagta hai. Ab wapas apne kaam par. Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe sixer sabse achha lagta hai.

director.text: 1 hisse
1 hisse sahi nahi hai. Pehli patti ke ek hisse ke theek neeche dekho, aur gino doosri patti ke kitne hisse us jagah mein aate hain. Kitne 1/6 hisse milkar ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: do hisse

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 6 hisse 3 ke do guna, toh tihaai mein do. Yeh teen chocolate ki pattiyan ek hi size ki hain. Pehli 3 doston mein barabar bati, doosri 5 mein, teesri 10 mein. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. In pattiyon ke 1/3, 1/10 aur 1/5 hisson ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak kram mein lagao.
director.card: In pattiyon ke 1/3, 1/10 aur 1/5 hisson ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak kram mein lagao.

director.text: 1/10 phir 1/5 phir 1/3

Haan, bilkul theek: 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala: 1/10, 1/5, 1/3. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek jaisi chocolate ki pattiyan barabar baantni hain. Tumhe aisa hissa chahiye jo 1/3 se chhota ho par 1/6 se bada. Patti kitne doston mein baantoge: 2, 4 ya 7? Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Socho, 2 dost patti baantein toh har ek ko kitna milta hai; baaki options ke liye bhi wahi socho. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?
pata nahi, aap batao

Har option mein ek dost ka hissa likho: 1/2, 1/4 aur 1/7, kyunki patti apne doston mein barabar bati hai. Ab 1/3 se chhote hisse chuno: 1/4 aur 1/7; 1/2 toh 1/3 se bada hai, kyunki do dost teen se kam hain, toh unka hissa bada. Tumhari baari: 1/4 ya 1/7, inmein se kaunsa hissa 1/6 se bada hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 1/4 ya 1/7, inmein se kaunsa hissa 1/6 se bada hai?

director.text: ek bata chaar

Sahi jawab. Dekho, dost jitne zyada, hissa utna chhota; 4 dost 3 aur 6 ke beech aate hain. Toh poora jawab: patti 4 doston mein baanto: har hissa 1/4, jo 1/3 se chhota aur 1/6 se bada hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/5 cake se chhota chahiye. 4 hisse karoge ya 6?
director.card: Ek cake ko barabar hisson mein kaatna hai, aur har hissa 1/5 cake se chhota chahiye. 4 hisse karoge ya 6?

director.text: chhah hisse

Bilkul sahi: 6 hisse karo toh har hissa 1/6, jo 1/5 se chhota; 4 se 1/4 milta, jo bada. Ek hi raste par ek cycle ne raste ka 1/6 hissa tay kiya, aur ek scooter ne 1/8. Kaun zyada door gaya, cycle ya scooter?
director.card: Ek hi raste par ek cycle ne raste ka 1/6 hissa tay kiya, aur ek scooter ne 1/8. Kaun zyada door gaya, cycle ya scooter?

director.text: cycle zyada door gayi
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki raasta ek hi hai; 1/6 ke liye woh 6 hisson mein bata, 8 se kam, toh 1/6 lamba. Zoya ne likha ki 1/8, 1/5 se bada hai, kyunki 8 bada number hai. Kya uski baat sahi hai?
director.card: Zoya ne likha ki 1/8, 1/5 se bada hai, kyunki 8 bada number hai. Kya uski baat sahi hai?

director.text: nahi

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 1/8 ke liye poora 8 hisson mein bata, 5 se zyada, toh 1/8 chhota hai, bada nahi. Ab ek se zyada cheezein barabar baantenge, jaise kuch roti kuch bachchon mein, aur har ek ka hissa bhinn mein likhenge. Ab tak samajh aaya?
ab main jaati hoon, bye
Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
